This week's links

Hello again. Five links this week, mostly about storage engines and one about keyboards, and nothing that takes longer than ten minutes.

1. Local-first mail is having a moment
https://demo.example.com/articles/local-first?utm_source=plainnews&utm_medium=email

2. SQLite 3.51 release notes
https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_51.html
Faster JSON and a new pragma for reading the WAL.

3. Terminal workflows that stuck
https://example.com/terminal-workflows
A year in the terminal and the tools that survived it.

4. Why sync engines need tombstones (https://example.org/tombstones)
Deletes are the hard part.

5. A keyboard I can type on for a whole day
https://keys.example.net/review
Low profile, quiet, and boring in the best way.
